description: Frozen prompt set for bun run lab:generation-bench. One-line preset descriptions, deliberately diverse across mood, motion, palette and audio targets. Regressions in prompt scaffolding, model routing or the synthesizer are scored against this set; edit it only deliberately, since baselines stop being comparable the moment it changes.
prompts: slow swirling deep-ocean currents with glowing jellyfish drifting to the bass
neon cyberpunk grid scrolling at night, treble sparks on the horizon
gentle golden-hour clouds pulsing softly with the mid range
vibrant tie-dye kaleidoscope blooming on every kick drum
cold blue starfield with slow parallax and rare treble twinkles
molten lava tunnel that surges forward when the bass drops
underwater cathedral of light rays swaying with the music
retro CRT scanlines and phosphor trails flickering to hi-hats
ink diffusing in water, blooming on the beat
aurora curtains rippling over an icy horizon, bass-driven waves
spiral galaxy arms winding tighter as the song builds
warm analog film grain with slow drifting dust motes
electric plasma arcs crawling across the screen with treble
black-and-white op-art tunnel pulsing to the kick
bouncing gel blobs squishing on every downbeat
shimmering soap-bubble iridescence wobbling gently with the vocals
dark forest fireflies blinking in time with the snare
vaporwave sunset with palm silhouettes and slow horizontal wave
particle swarm flocking that scatters on drum fills
crystal cave refractions rotating slowly, flashing on cymbals
